Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production sprite atlas for a compact pixel-art lightning survival game.
Create one transparent PNG sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells, no borders, labels, text, background, or separators. 1024 by 1024 canvas. Each 256px cell represents a 32x32 logical pixel sprite, nearest-neighbor enlarged with crisp square 8px pixels. Keep every sprite exactly centered at the same pivot, surrounded by transparent padding. No anti-aliasing or blur. Restrained high-quality SNES pixel electrical effects in only four neutral shades: dark steel gray, silver, ice white and white; the game applies cyan or gold tint. Actual transparent empty center where specified.
Row 1: FOUR successive animation frames of ball lightning. A small luminous spherical core about 8 logical pixels diameter, with two asymmetric jagged electrical arcs wrapping around it at a radius of 8-11 logical pixels, one short branching spark. It must look like unstable contained electricity, not a smooth flying marble. White energy core, sparse dark broken rim; distinct angular crackle each frame. Total silhouette at most 24 logical pixels.
Row 2: FOUR successive animation frames of a capacitor CHARGING halo around an invisible electron. Transparent central hole 14 logical pixels across. Three separated thin jagged crescents at radius 9-12 logical pixels and two inward-facing tiny sparks suggest energy tightening inward. Do not draw a sphere or a solid circular UI ring. Frames animate flickering electrical filaments, equal overall volume so opacity and scale can encode amount of stored energy in game. Maximum silhouette 28 logical pixels.
Row 3: FOUR successive animation frames of a berserk electrical corona around an invisible electron, open transparent central hole 14 logical pixels. Four asymmetrical angled lightning tongues following a compact circular contour with small gaps, one slightly longer fork leaning right. Dynamic energetic but clean, no flames, no star shape, no square/diamond enclosure. 26 logical pixels maximum. Animation changes the jagged paths, not the center or outer size.
Row 4: FOUR sequential frames of a small electrical RECONNECTION snap where a returning lightning strand touches an electron. Frame1 a tight opposing jagged arc pair, frame2 a crisp broken ring with two tiny forks, frame3 separated fading arc fragments, frame4 just two sparse residual sparks. Central hole at least 10 logical pixels, maximum diameter 22 logical pixels. No impact cross or giant star.
Keep the four effects stylistically unified, readable at the actual 32x32 pixel size and unobtrusive among many small spherical enemies. Avoid excessive branches, fog, glow clouds, shading noise, debris, illustrated backgrounds, gradients, smooth vector curves, UI icons, perspective. Each cell isolated with at least 2 logical pixels padding. Deliver the sprite sheet itself.
refinement: Edit the provided sprite atlas. Keep its exact 4-column 4-row arrangement and the same effect meaning/order (orb, charge halo, berserk corona, reconnection), four animation frames in each row. Keep the transparent background and cell centers. Radically simplify the electrical marks: remove ALL bulky metallic gray shapes, outer bevels, dark outlines, gray clouds, and wide borders. Render ONLY thin bright jagged lightning filaments, each one logical pixel wide with an occasional 2-pixel knot. Each logical pixel is a crisp 8x8 square. No soft edges. The filaments should resemble tiny hand-pixeled lightning, not metal shuriken or stone. Use pure ice white and a small amount of pale blue-gray, no blue/green background residues. Most of every cell must remain transparent. Orb row keeps its small 8-logical-pixel luminous spherical core and sparse thin broken electricity around it. Other rows have a fully empty central hole at least 14 logical pixels in diameter so the electron shows through; only slender electricity outside the hole. Corona looks like a broken jagged electric circle, never a four-point star. Return final frame only two sparse sparks. This is a production transparent game sprite sheet; crisp native pixel shapes, restrained detail, no text.
